EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Having such a deserted exhibition
hall probably makes the people
of {{TAG:0005:0005:}} feel embarrassed.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}You don't have to come all the time,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
but hopefully we'll soon get more
donations,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Da pena ver la colección del museo.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Está más desierta que un pueblo
del Oeste en un duelo al amanecer.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}No hace falta que la visites siempre,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, pero cualquier donación
será bien recibida, claro.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Une salle d'exposition aussi vide,
c'est un peu embarrassant pour
l'image {{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}, non ?
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Hésite pas à repasser à l'occase,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, le musée finira bien par
recevoir des dons !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Gli abitanti di {{TAG:0005:0005:}}
dovrebbero vergognarsi!
Un'esposizione così scarna, ma dai!
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Spero che ci darai una mano
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}donandoci i fossili che trovi
in giro,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ich hoffe, diese leere
Ausstellungshalle ist den Leuten in
{{TAG:0005:0005:}} nicht peinlich.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ein paar gestiftete Fossilien mehr
wären aber tatsächlich ganz nett{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's slow going,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} but our collection of
fossils is getting bigger,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La colección de fósiles aumenta 
poco a poco,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ça progresse doucement, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}mais
petit à petit, notre collection de
fossiles s'agrandit,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La nostra collezione di fossili{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} si sta
a poco a poco ingrandendo,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Es geht zwar schleppend voran,
aber immerhin wächst unsere
Fossiliensammlung,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}As you collect fossils,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} don't you
often get surprised to see how big
they actually are, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Por escondidos que estén, siempre 
acabamos dando con ellos,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ¿no,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}? ¡Algunos son enormes!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'est impressionnant de voir la taille
de certains fossiles, non ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}On s'en rend pas compte quand on
les ramasse !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ti capita mai di trovare un fossile
e di stupirti{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} nel vedere quanto
è grande, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bist du auch manchmal erstaunt,
wie groß diese Fossilien werden,
wenn man sie zusammensetzt?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Fosil toplarken,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} aslında ne kadar büyük
olduklarını görünce sık sık şaşırmıyor
musun, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wow, it's hard to imagine these
creatures used to roam the planet
so long ago,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} huh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oye, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ¿a que es increíble
que estos animales camparan a sus
anchas por {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ouah, difficile de croire que ces
créatures gigantesques ont foulé le
sol de notre planète un jour,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hein ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sorbole, sembra impossibile che
in passato ci fossero in giro
creature del genere,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} eh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Schwer vorstellbar, dass diese
Kreaturen vor so langer Zeit hier
gelebt haben,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} was, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Look,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Our wonderful
fossil collection has come so far!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}It's like an all-star team of fossils!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I bet it'd be pretty hard to find an
exhibition hall as complete as this
one,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Regarde,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Notre super
collection de fossiles est complète !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Peu de villes peuvent se vanter d'en
avoir une aussi belle,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Imagine, on pourrait faire de super
équipes de dinofoot avec tous ces
spécimens !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Guarda,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} La nostra
collezione di fossili è bellissima!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}La farei sfilare in passerella!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Credo non sia facile trovarne una
altrettanto ricca,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sieh dir das an,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Unsere
Fossiliensammlung ist komplett!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}So ein All-Star-Team der Fossilien
sieht man nicht oft,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bak,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Müthiş fosil
koleksiyonumuz nereden nereye geldi!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Resmen fosillerden oluşan yıldızlar takımı!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bunun kadar eksiksiz bir sergi salonu
bulmak bayağı zor olur,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Du bist bestimmt enttäuscht von
diesem Raum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0013:}}Bis jetzt
gibt's hier nämlich kaum Fossilien{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Aber wenn du schon mal hier bist,
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}kannst du ja stattdessen mich
bewundern!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}We only have a small collection
of fossils,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} so you might be a bit
unsatisfied with how it is now{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But please give us some time to
work on it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! Making new
fossils takes a while!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wir haben hier noch nicht viele
Fossilien,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} also bist du wohl nicht
besonders beeindruckt{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aber nur Geduld! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Wir arbeiten
daran,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Fosil koleksiyonumuz küçük,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} bu yüzden
şu hâli seni biraz tatmin etmeyebilir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ama
biraz zaman tanı lütfen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! Yeni
fosil yapmak vakit alıyor!

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} how's the fossil
collection here in comparison
to the one in your town?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Recently,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} our collection has grown,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
so we're finally at this point now
where it looks good,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Dime, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ¿cómo es esta
colección de fósiles comparada con
la de tu pueblo?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Últimamente la hemos ampliado
y parece una colección bastante
digna,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
Dis, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} elle est comment la
collection de fossiles dans ta ville
par rapport à ici, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Récemment,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} notre collection s'est
agrandie,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} et elle commence enfin à
ressembler à quelque chose !
IT:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} ti sembra migliore
la nostra collezione di fossili o
quella della tua città?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ultimamente,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} la nostra si
è arricchita{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} e adesso non è niente
male, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}gibt es in deiner Stadt
auch so eine große Sammlung von
Fossilien wie bei uns?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}In letzter Zeit ist unsere Sammlung
ziemlich gewachsen und kann sich
echt sehen lassen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} buradaki fosil koleksiyonu
senin kasabandakiyle kıyaslayınca nasıl?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Son zamanlarda{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} koleksiyonumuz büyüdü,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
artık sonunda göze güzel görünmeye
başladı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Laquelle de nos villes aura complété
sa collection de fossiles en
premier{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}?
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Suspense !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich bin gespannt, welche
Fossiliensammlung als Erstes
komplett sein wird, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Die in deiner Stadt oder die in
meiner!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}¡Los fósiles de esta colección brillan
como estrellas en el firmamento!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} No
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}te esperes fósiles fosforescentes...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me refiero a que la colección está
completa,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. ¿A que es
impresionante?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡Disfruta y aprende!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}La galerie des fossiles a vraiment
du style maintenant !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Il ne nous en
manque pas un seul.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ça a de l'allure, pas vrai ?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Prends
ton temps pour admirer,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, vas-y !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}L'esposizione di fossili è il fiore
all'occhiello della nostra città!{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Completa in ogni sua parte.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}È bella, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} Spero che vorrai
ammirarla anche tu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
